items.prompt: A screen shows a nonzero parity gap. What would you check before interpreting it as executable arbitrage?
items.modelAnswer: Matched underlying/style/expiry/strike/deliverable/currency, dividends/discount/funding, synchronized executable bid/ask/size, fees/borrow/shorting/margin and settlement/operational risks. The diagnostic grants no permission or guarantee.

criteria.text: Uses executable sides and frictions, not mid-only arithmetic.
Does not turn a formula into trading authority.
